_comment: The diplomacy audience (wire ids 57 player, 58 AI; open fixes 46 and 47), work order 185 part 10. Geometry is screens/audience/augeom.py (transcribed from dip_scrn_main.cpp and fields.cpp); every word on the screen is the engine's, carried by open fix 47's DIPL block; the stage is DIPLOMAT.LBX's own art. The marks name every difference, each held by the audience smoke group and named in ~/orionlayerv3-dev/v3_projektstatus.md.

marks.deviation_hud_frameless: HUD panels behind the statement and the menu, where the original prints on the room.
marks.omission_talking_loop: The ambassador's animation is not drawn: its phase is not on the wire. The still is the frame the original shows with animations off.
marks.omission_header_line: JIMTEXT2's header line at (320, 10) — 'Player n: name' or 'race Ambassador' — needs an extraction this order does not add.
marks.omission_audience_help: The right click's help in the audience is not built (help.json has no regions).
marks.omission_glass_remap: The ambassador's glassed pixels are drawn as their palette indices, a hatching; the original remaps them against what lies beneath (Update_Glass_Remap_Colors_, dip_scrn_main.cpp:476). The engine's own framebuffer shows the same hatching (part 11, side by side), so the remap's effect, if any, lies beyond what the wire shows — not measured.
marks.omission_fade_in: The room's fade-in (up to 38 frames of the room's entry before the ambassador appears, dip_scrn_main.cpp:1985-2016) is not played: HD shows the ambassador and the statement at once, where the original still fades (seen side by side, part 11).
